messages.subject: RE: Prohibition Notice PN/WM/2026/00214 - PT-DB-07
messages.plaintextBody:
Richard,

Thank you. The Notice is in order and we agree it should be complied with - PT-DB-07 must stay out of service until the guarding is made effective and verified. There's a 21-day appeal window but an appeal would not suspend an immediate Prohibition Notice and, in any event, we would not advise appealing: the right course is to remedy and evidence it. We'll fold this into the strategy.

Tom
